Outputs are completed passenger service, real fare receipts, and exception handover records. Receiving an order does not mean the trip is complete, fare turnover is not employee wages or personal net income, and permission and safety status are checked separately.

Communicate with passengers, dispatch, and repair service personnel to locate the vehicle, destination, fare, and exception, and clarify who handles repair or complaints. Customer service communication does not replace your own driving safety responsibility or the organization's carrier responsibility.

description.text: Taxi drivers drive vehicles to transport passengers on demand and collect fares, usually using a metered device; they also confirm pickup needs, communicate with dispatch, check vehicle condition, assist with boarding and alighting, and record exceptions. This page uses O*NET-SOC53-3054.00 as its baseline and does not merge prearranged pickup 53-3053 or bus passenger transport. In China, cruise and ride-hailing businesses separately check the driver's license, practitioner qualification registration, vehicle and business permits, and local requirements; the paper experience grants no actual passenger operating qualification.
